gallery-white.$description: Gallery White — Global navigation fill, light product panels, light icons, and inverse text

cloud-gray.$description: Cloud Gray — Alternate section backgrounds, quiet cards, footer bands, and pale control surfaces

studio-white.$description: Studio White — Primary document canvas and white-on-dark display text

graphite.$description: Graphite — Primary headlines, body copy, dark media cards, and dark iconography

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary editorial copy and supporting headings

steel.$description: Steel — Muted explanatory copy and de-emphasized labels

divider-gray.$description: Divider Gray — Hairline section and footer dividers

control-mist.$description: Control Mist — Pale media-control and subdued action backgrounds

apple-blue.$description: Apple Blue — Filled purchase buttons and keyboard focus treatment — a concentrated blue mark against otherwise neutral controls

link-blue.$description: Link Blue — Text links, film links, and inline disclosure affordances

new-orange.$description: New Orange — New-product labels and limited-status annotations

sf-pro-display.$description: Display and section headlines. The 600 weight remains controlled rather than heavy; hero headlines scale to 64px/68px and cinematic chapter statements to 80px/84px. Tracking tightens as type grows: -0.58px at 64px and -1.2px at 80px, while compact labels open slightly to +0.20px at 28px.

sf-pro-text.$description: Navigation, purchase controls, links, body copy, badges, and footer text. Small navigation uses 12px/12px at -0.12px tracking; standard readable copy uses 17px with -0.37px tracking; 600 distinguishes product names and pricing without changing the family.
